name: Sultans Trail Section 5: Sofia - Rhodope - Edirne
description_md:
Sultans Trail Section 5: Sofia - Rhodope - Edirne is a waymarked hiking route in BG signposted as ST5. The international waymarked hiking network includes this hard route, which measures 596.8 km with 18682 m of ascent and 19167 m of descent.

Walking time takes about 200 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes Sofia Metro within 200 m, the National Assembly of the Republic of Bulgaria within 900 m, and the Rila Monastery Ecclesiastical and Historical Museum within 100 m.
